sources.title: South Sudan Ministry of Interior: eVisa service
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live .gov.ss site identifies the Ministry of Interior, South Sudan National Police, Directorate of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passports and Immigration and Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service as the Government eServices operator. Its HTML was last modified 22 July 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Are you eligible for a South Sudan Visa? Start the application process by creating an account.

sources.title: South Sudan Immigration eServices: foreign visitors
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Directorate of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passports and Immigration
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Ministry of Interior immigration eServices home identifies the Directorate and Department of E-Visa and Immigration Services. It says citizens, foreign residents and foreign visitors can apply for Government services, without publishing a visa-eligibility schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: South Sudan Citizens, Foreign Residents, and Foreign visitors to South Sudan can now apply for Government services.

sources.title: South Sudan Ministry of Labour: Ministry of Interior and Immigration Services directory
sources.publisher: Ministry of Labour, Republic of South Sudan
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Ministry of Labour directory identifies evisa.gov.ss as the website for the Ministry of Interior Directorate of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passports and Immigration and Department of E-Visa and Immigration Services.

sources.title: Government of Canada: South Sudan entry requirements
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Canadian guidance, last updated 20 August 2026, distinguishes regular Canadian passports and directs Canadian travellers to obtain a South Sudan eVisa before departure. Canada is not part of this residual cohort and this source is not extrapolated to unlisted nationalities.
sources.supportingExcerpt: You must obtain your e-visa online through the government’s website prior to departure to South Sudan.
